text: In the last weekend before the old Yankee Pedlar Inn closes, its only two employees, Claire and Luke, [hunt for proof of its hauntings|trigger|digging into a mystery] with recorders and a website. The story that fascinates them is that of Madeline O'Malley, [a bride who hanged herself when left at the altar|wrong|love betrayed], her body hidden in the basement. A former actress turned medium checks in and warns Claire not to go down there, but the piano plays by itself, and [the basement keeps calling her back|threat|evil places].
